title: Hello, old friend: living with fear
kicker: A kinder way to treat your fear
blurb: Fear is an old companion trying to keep you safe. A gentle film about neither obeying it nor fighting it.
description: A short, storybook-style film that treats fear as a small, loyal companion with one job: keeping you alive. It describes the two usual responses, obeying and fighting, and offers a third way: let fear come along, kneel to it as you would to a frightened child, and walk through the door together.
takeaways: Fear's job is protection, and it cannot tell a cliff from a job interview.
Obeying fear shrinks life one room at a time, and ignoring it tends to make it louder.
Putting a feeling into words has been found to quiet the brain's alarm response.
Fear does not have to leave for you to move; it can come with you, just not drive.
Try a hand on your chest and a sentence you would say to a child in the dark.
